name: @peartube/desktop-native
description: Native macOS shell scaffold for PearTube

scripts.generate: npm run ensure:barekit-echo && npm run ensure:barekit-bare-fs && npm run ensure:barekit-corestore && npm run ensure:bare-runtime && npm run ensure:host-sidecar && npm run ensure:host-worklet && npm run ensure:host-worklet-frameworks && npm run ensure:bare-mpv-prebuilds && xcodegen generate
scripts.build: npm run generate && xcodebuild -project PearTubeDesktop.xcodeproj -scheme PearTubeDesktop -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build build
scripts.test:bridge: npm run ensure:barekit-echo && npm run ensure:barekit-bare-fs && npm run ensure:barekit-corestore && npm run ensure:bare-runtime && npm run ensure:host-sidecar && npm run ensure:host-worklet && npm run ensure:host-worklet-frameworks && npm run ensure:bare-mpv-prebuilds && node --test scripts/bare-pack-host-flags.test.mjs scripts/barekit-build-contract.test.mjs Bridge/bridge-core.test.mjs Bridge/native-rpc.test.mjs Bridge/playback-resolution.test.mjs Bridge/sidecar-addon-roots.test.mjs Bridge/native-host-sidecar.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run generate && npm run test:bridge && xcodebuild -project PearTubeDesktop.xcodeproj -scheme PearTubeDesktop -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build test
